text:
Sofie Park: heads up 60; QuantaHealth (acct ..3307) autopay failed at 02:12 PT. invoices QH-4401 and QH-4402 impacted.
Noah Reed: decline reason?
billing-bot: alert: payment_method=card_last4=3307 status=declined code=expired_card attempts=1
CS-Liam: i messaged their AP. they confirmed the card expired and asked to set up ACH instead. asked for ACH link and expected timing.
Sofie Park: ok let's offer ACH + optional immediate manual payment via card if they update. do one single auto-retry in 1h, then pause. hold dunning for 48h while AP updates.
Noah Reed: noted. also request that client attach remittance (screenshot) once ACH initiated so AR can reconcile faster.
CS-Liam: pasted ACH link to customer: https://billing.redwood.ai/ach-setup and asked them to confirm when they submit.
billing-bot: action logged: scheduled_auto_retry at=1773458490 attempts=2 ticket=AR-1297
AR-Ella: when they switch to ACH, please ensure we collect ACH authorization name, routing number, and account holder name. do not store full bank numbers in slack.
Sofie Park: agreed. i'll prepare a short checklist for CS to collect: 1) ACH confirmation screenshot 2) remittance email with invoice numbers 3) ACH authorization PDF.
CS-Liam: client replied: "we'll submit ACH today; funds expected 1-2 business days. sending remittance after submission." attached small photo named remit_qh.jpg
Noah Reed: please upload that remit photo to AR-1297 and mark invoices pending_ach.
billing-bot: file uploaded to AR-1297: remit_qh.jpg; status updated= pending_ach
AR-Ella: updated AR ticket. current outstanding ~12,450 USD. threshold for service hold = 25,000 so no hold for now. set follow-up reminder 48h.
Sofie Park: also add a note to CRM to avoid repeated auto-retries for expired cards; set account flag=card_expired.
CS-Liam: noted. client requested wire template in case ACH fails; i provided minimal wording (no acct numbers):
```
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference Inc.
Bank name: First Partner Bank
Routing/SWIFT: [please provide]
Reference: QuantaHealth + invoice numbers
```
Noah Reed: perfect. if ACH fails after 48h escalate to AR for outreach.
Sofie Park: closing loop: immediate retry scheduled, client actively communicating, tickets AR-1297 and CS-442 open. reminder set for 1773459145 (~48h). thanks all :thumbsup:
